svg.title: Write to me. — Open to work, worldwide
svg.desc: Freelance or NDA project in mind? Write to me. “I’m open to remote work worldwide — freelance first, contract and full-time too — and happy to work under NDA. Tell me what you’re building.” — Harsh. Email harshbhx@gmail.com — opens a pre-filled email about a role. An airmail envelope addressed to Harsh Bhanushali, Vadodara, Gujarat, India; also linkedin.com/in/harshu-dev, dualmindlab.tech and Discord harshu911. The stamp is Harsh’s portrait over “Vadodara”; the postmark reads “Open to work, worldwide”, IST (UTC+5:30).
